A new space of opportunity

Physical spaces that work for the people who move through them.

Whoever manages a space now has a new kind of operator: agents that turn a budget into personalized experiences, better coordinated services and indicators of how people live the space.

For visitors, it starts simply: scan or tap, enter the space, explore.

01

Space managers and hosts

Venue operators, event hosts, campus and building managers. They set the mandate, approve what needs approval and see every payment.

↗
02

The people in the space

Attendees, students, workers and visitors get experiences shaped to them: where to go, what is on and who to meet.

↗
03

Brands and sponsors

They pay the space for screen time and activations, so the space earns as well as spends.

↗

What a space gains

A

Personalized experiences

Each person finds what matters to them: sessions, stands, people and offers, in 3D, on screens or in AR.

B

Efficiency

Agents buy data, AI and content per request under caps you set. Suppliers and services wait for your approval.

C

Wellbeing indicators

Objectives, participation and how people use the space, measured so you can show what your space gives back.

Services

What we deliver for each space.

Each service shows where it stands today: available, piloted on Stellar testnet, planned or built on request.

Available

Digital twin and AR activations

A 3D version of your space with QR and NFC entry points, plus experimental AR paths on supported devices. Physical AR placement is not yet verified.

Recorded testnet run

Agent operations under a mandate

Recorded objectives, credits and a cap per purchase. Agents buy data and content over x402; purchases above the cap are blocked for operator review.

Pilot

Paid screen time and sponsorships

The dashboard shows a recorded 5-test-USDC screen order. Passkey checkout, creative review and screen delivery are part of a separate controlled pilot.

Pilot

Visitor wallet and Passport

A passkey wallet with test USDC and a Stellar Passport asset demo. Profile synchronization remains planned. No seed phrase.

Planned

Indicators and reports

Progress on each objective, what each credit bought, what the space earned and how people took part.

On request

Custom environments and integrations

Your venue modeled in 3D, your channels and data sources connected, your suppliers in the catalog.

Where each layer stands

A space can do more than display content.

We start with a place people can explore, then add the capabilities that make sense for its owner, partners and visitors.

Available

A shared spatial experience

Pilot

Wallet access in Stellar Testnet

Programmable advertising

Authorized agent services

The platform underneath

Built around a place.
Open to what comes next.

Organizers can commission custom immersive environments. Brands and developers can commission activations and services within those spaces. Programmable advertising is the next product layer.

Discovery in the browser

Web 3D, QR/NFC access and AR pathways on supported devices, without making a wallet the first step.

Stellar for the transaction layer

The agent demo combines x402 and test USDC with a SEP-41 budget ceiling. The dashboard shows a paid ad order recorded in a Soroban contract. Visitor wallets remain a separate pilot.
